modifications: None to the bsf package. Training and evaluation harness is our own.
audit: Paper Grassmannian: shared positive gain, periodic QR retraction. Released code: one unconstrained gain per group, differentiable QR each forward.
Paper Group Lasso: block soft threshold and group penalty. Released GroupLassoBSF: signed BlockJumpReLU, straight-through gradients, learned thresholds and dual control of mean active groups.
Released trainer defaults to denoising (snr=0.1); synthetic paper protocol has no added noise.
Repository contains rabbit starter demos, not a complete reproduction script for Appendix H or all ImageNet sweeps.
